sprint: Place rotation (both surfaces) -- BACKLOG.md ship-order task #552. A Place gains a genuine, whole-Place rotation capability: the Place's chrome (border/mat/ornament/caption/Place-1 Layer Packs) AND every Place-hosted Layer rotate together as one unit around the Place's own centre, exactly as if a printed physical picture on a wall were tilted. A new rotatable Guardrail (default CLOSED, matching resizable's own convention -- no already-published Theme silently gains a Story-Author rotation control it never authored). Rotation is stored as slide.metadata.elementOverrides[placeId].rotation via SceneEngine.setContentOverride (Story-Author override) with a Theme-Author-authored placeRects[i].rotation as the compiled base -- the same tri-state precedence every other rotation-aware field on the platform already uses (Story-Author override wins over Theme-Author base). A new Rotation slider in js/selectionActionStrip.js's Place edit popup is gated on the rotatable Guardrail (never shown for a non-rotatable Place, matching how the Shape picker is only shown when resizable is opted in), writing through the shared _afterPlaceEdit tail so Object Strip/Runtime Preview all live-refresh on every drag tick. Rendering: renderer/slideRenderer.js's _drawPlaceOne wrap at the reorderable-loop entry (lines 3800-3835) rotates the artwork/ornament/caption pipeline around the Place's own centre via the established save/translate/rotate/translate/restore idiom; Place 1's mat/fill/panel drawn ONCE outside the loop (lines 3681-3686) also rotates when rotation is present. Compile step: tools/world-builder-v2/js/services/builder.js's convergeScene carries holder.permissions.resizable/rotatable AND placeRects[i].rotation onto the compiled Layout, matching the existing 'absent = closed' default asymmetry for both Guardrails. Both engines mirrored in lockstep: engineRuntime.js's _paintHolder rotates chrome+content together the same way. Verified 26/26 assertions via place_rotation_verify.js -- rotation permission genuinely opts in (a non-rotatable Place shows zero Rotation slider, Guardrail honoured), a real mouse-driven slider drag persists the override AND the render tree bbox visibly rotates on both engines (differCount 1/36 grid-sample pixel-diff proof against a distinctive 4-quadrant test image, since a solid-colour fixture cannot distinguish rotation), Theme-Author-authored base rotation genuinely renders when no Story-Author override exists, override wins over base when both present, non-square Place at non-orthogonal angle (45deg) prevents the square-rotation-lands-on-itself pitfall. Full regression: goldenBuild.js (v1 and v2) PASS, place_resize_shape_verify.js zero failures, place_guardrails_runtime_verify.js 10/0, museum_realfile_pixelhash.js byte-identical hash SHA-256 e7b2a905613dbef3d2f9064211103d84762d7039d3bee404df90f4d90899b390 confirming zero visual/rendering regression.
